title: Bound states in the continuum through quantum interference in ultracold atomic collisions

comments: Clean quantum-interference control of open-system dynamics with potential applications to non-Hermitian engineering, though practical utility beyond fundamental physics remains unclear.

title: Examining cyclic modulation of hormones, immune cells and microbiota profiles during the menstrual cycle in Macaca mulatta
task: Characterize hormonal, immune, and microbiota dynamics across menstrual cycles in female primates
key_results: Estradiol peaked at ovulation and progesterone during luteal phase with consistent patterns; cervicovaginal leukocytes positively associated with elevated estradiol; vaginal microbial composition remained stable across cycle phases with interindividual variability dominating
comments: While the study demonstrates cyclical consistency rather than variability, the small sample size (n=6) and single primate species limit generalizability to human female physiology and disease models.
